# Exact Better V2 Touch Plan

## Observed live evidence
- Three bordered surfaces remain visible above the fold.
- Prompt and Mode are separated by 23px of combined spacing.
- Quick-start controls render at 139px each and still read like cards.
- Prompt and Mode each carry an 8px standalone radius.
- Glass is already 13px and healthy; no heavier blur is needed.
- Navigation is quiet at 0.52 opacity for inactive tabs, but lacks a single active-light rail.
- No horizontal overflow, console errors, or failed public requests were observed.

## Exact intended source touch set
- `scripts/ui/DirectorStyles.js` — full rewrite only to load Better V2 layers last.
- `styles/unified-deck.css` — new: visually fuse Prompt and Mode, reduce seams and framing.
- `styles/cinematic-controls.css` — new: thinner quick-start capsules and stronger physical mode tabs.
- `styles/ignition-nav.css` — new: Generate readiness treatment and bottom-nav active rail.
- `styles/aurora-depth.css` — new: low-cost focus-responsive spectral depth using pseudo-elements.
- `tests/better-v2-smoke.cjs` — new: measured browser regression for fusion, capsules, motion, focus, nav, Generate, overflow.

No API, persistence, generation, asset, pricing, or provider files should change.
